chunks: Seek the descent of sustenance through charity.

key_terms.الرِّزْقَ: Sustenance, provision, and livelihood granted by Allah
key_terms.اِسْتَنْزِلُوا: Seek to bring down or obtain
key_terms.بِالصَّدَقَةِ: Through charity; by giving in charity

ai.seo_question: How does charity relate to receiving sustenance in Islam?
ai.summary: This concise prophetic teaching encourages giving charity as a means of seeking rizq from Allah. It links material provision with generosity, teaching that acts of giving can become a cause for divine increase and blessing.
